Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Inquiry list filters now require Search, matching Student Master" --category Improvement --description "Changing a filter \(status, training, dates, etc.\) on the Inquiry Listing no longer auto-searches instantly — you now click Search or press Enter, consistent with the Student Master list.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Fixed inquiry edit-and-return losing filtered results" --category Fix --description "Editing an inquiry while filtered to a training programme containing a special character \(e.g. 'Piping Design & Drafting'\) could return to an empty list. Caused by a redundant URL decode step corrupting the encoded ampersand.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Fixed website inquiries being mislabeled and duplicate leads swallowing new ones" --category Fix --description "The suvidya.ac.in website sync was tagging new leads as 'Online Inquiry' instead of 'Website', and separately was merging genuinely new inquiries into old/unrelated existing records by phone or email match instead of creating new ones. Both are fixed; going forward every incoming lead creates its own inquiry record.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Full Payment discount now logged in fee details" --category Feature --description "Students who choose Full Payment on the admission form get a 5% discount; it's now written as its own line item in the fee ledger so the balance correctly nets to zero, instead of the discount being an invisible gap.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Attendance page now shows Transferred/Cancelled students" --category Improvement --description "Cancelled admissions are no longer silently hidden from the attendance sheet, and transferred students now show the same Transferred/Moved badge used on the batch-wise fees report.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Fixed transferred students disappearing from their new batch" --category Fix --description "Marking a student as Transferred only recorded where they were moving to, without actually moving their enrolment record — so they never showed up in Allot Roll Number or Attendance for the new batch. Transferring a student now correctly moves \(or recreates\) their admission record under the destination batch.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Removed Code column from attendance page" --category Update --description "Dropped the Student Code column from both the desktop table and mobile card view to declutter the attendance sheet.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Fixed duplicated payment rows in Fees Report" --category Fix --description "Students with more than one admission record in the same batch \(e.g. from historical transfers\) had their fee ledger rows duplicated in the batch-wise fees report, overstating their Total Paid. Fixed at the source so the on-screen table, Excel export, and PDF export are all correct.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Fees Report PDF now matches Excel and hides students without a roll number" --category Improvement --description "The PDF export used a different, independent query than Excel and could show a different set of students. It now uses the same student list and logic as Excel, and both now exclude students who haven't been allotted a roll number yet.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Fee receipts now show Cancelled/Transferred labels" --category Fix --description "Individual payment receipts \(both the add-fees page and the per-student fee-details page\) now print the same Cancelled/Transferred status tag already shown on the batch-wise fees report — the data was already available, it just wasn't in the printed receipt template.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Fixed \\"Mark As Cancelled\\" button under Edit Student" --category Fix --description "The button only changed a generic Status field that no Cancelled badge or report anywhere actually reads. It now correctly writes admission_master.Cancel — the field every Cancelled badge, the fees report, receipts, and attendance page all check — and added an Un-cancel action alongside it.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Transferred badge now shows source batch" --category Improvement --description "The Transferred tag now displays the batch a student was moved FROM in addition to the destination batch, across Fees Report \(table/Excel/PDF\), attendance, Edit Student, and fee receipts.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Student Master shows Cancelled/Transferred tags; legacy data imported" --category Improvement --description "Student Master list now shows Cancelled and Transferred \(from→to batch\) tags, including previously-cancelled students that were formerly hidden from the list. Also ran a one-time import backfilling Cancelled/Transferred status for students whose cancellation or batch transfer only ever happened in the legacy system \(16 cancellations + 680 transfers imported\).")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Cleaned up duplicate admission records" --category Fix --description "Traced the legacy system's 'Total Student' count \(17,649\) to its exact source query and found 19 genuine duplicate/orphan admission_master rows inflating our count to 17,842. Re-pointed 16 linked fee/attendance rows onto the correct admission, then soft-deleted the 19 duplicates — count is now 17,823 \(legacy total + 174 legitimate new admissions\), no data lost.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Student Master no longer hides admitted students by Status_id drift" --category Fix --description "Removed the Status_id=8 requirement from the Student Master list filter. That column can lag behind a student's real admission \(a known sync-drift bug\), which was silently hiding ~333 genuinely admitted students from the list and its total count. The list now shows any student with an active, non-deleted admission \(16,340 total, up from 16,062\), while still showing each student once even if they have admissions across multiple batches from a transfer.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Student Master 'Total Student' now matches legacy exactly" --category Fix --description "The 'Total Student' header on the Student Master page now reproduces the legacy system's exact count formula \(COUNT of active, non-deleted admission_master rows\) — currently 17,823. The pagination/list itself still shows one row per student \(no duplicates\), so this is tracked as a separate figure from the list's own page-through total.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Full Payment discount entry now self-heals on fee details page" --category Fix --description "Found that all 10 current Full Payment admissions were missing their automatic 5% discount ledger entry — the original logic only ran at the exact moment an admission was first accepted, so students admitted before that logic existed never got it. Added a self-healing check to the fee-details API: any student on Full Payment mode without a logged discount gets it created the moment their page is viewed. Also backfilled 9 of the 10 existing gaps directly \(1 batch, 03091, has no fee amount configured yet so its discount can't be computed until that's set\).")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Software Changelog moved to navbar icon; removed from Utility menu" --category Improvement --description "Replaced the non-functional browser-notification bell button in the top navbar with a direct link to the Software Changelog page, and removed the old 'Utility > Software Changelog' menu entry now that it's always visible.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Fixed duplicate students in Student Master search" --category Fix --description "Found and cleaned 46 cases where repeated online-admission form submissions had created duplicate student+admission records for the same person \(71 duplicate admission rows total, alongside their one genuine admitted record\). Reassigned 15 linked fee/attendance rows onto the genuine record first, then retired the duplicates — Student Master now shows one entry per real person. 63 other name+mobile matches with multiple genuinely-admitted records were left untouched pending manual review \(could be legitimate re-enrollments\).")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Student Master pagination now matches legacy total count" --category Fix --description "Pagination \('1-25 of X'\) now shows the same legacy-formula total as the 'Total Student' header when no search is active, instead of a smaller deduped count. Searching still shows the actual number of matching results, since the legacy global count wouldn't make sense next to a handful of search matches.")

Bash(node scripts/log-change.mjs --title "Navbar changelog link now labeled 'Software Updates'" --category Improvement --description "The changelog navbar icon now shows the full label 'Software Updates' next to the icon, instead of being icon-only.")
